_comment: Copy to voice_rules.json and edit. Rules are how the voice-lint tool enforces YOUR writing voice. 'hard' rules are pass/fail (fix to zero before delivery); 'soft' rules only report density. Each rule = [label, python-regex]; soft rules take an optional 3rd number = per-1000-char density threshold. Build these from YOUR own writing habits — what YOU never do (see templates/VOICE_PROFILE.template.md). Below are generic Chinese-academic defaults to start from.
hard: Em-dash / double-hyphen (should be 0 in formal zh prose)
恰恰是|之所在|價值所在|真正的[^，。]{0,8}(在於|重量|價值)
soft: 一[具個種套位條場道份隻]
